title: Crypto Corn Surge
description: A surreal corn cob made entirely of metallic cryptocurrency coins and circuits stands upright, its yellow husks peeling back like dripping tar. The dramatic sky swirls with dark clouds, purple and yellow light, while shattered crystalline fragments explode outward from the cob amid glowing embers and liquid drips pooling at the base.
prompt: A towering ear of corn made from metallic cryptocurrency coins and circuit boards, dramatically emerging from melting yellow and black husks that drip like tar onto the ground. Shattered crystalline fragments and glowing embers explode from the cob. Dark apocalyptic sky with swirling purple, pink and yellow clouds, cinematic lighting, highly detailed surreal digital artwork.
